blocks.text: Allaah's Name Al-Mu'min The Giver of Security is found in one aayah where Allaah says,

He is Allah than Whom there is La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) the King, the Holy, the One Free from all defects, the Giver of security, the Watcher over His creatures, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glory be to Allah! (High is He) above all that they associate as partners with Him.

Allaah's Name Al-Mu'min indicates magnificent meanings and lofty affairs. From the meanings of His Name Al-Mu'min is His witnessing tawheed for Himself (singling Allaah out alone for worship). It is the greatest witness, from the Greatest Witness for the greatest of things to witness.
Mujaahid said, "Al-Mu'min The Giver of Security. The One who singles Himself out by the statement
Allah bears witness that La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He)

Another meaning of Al-Mu'min is the One who attests His Messengers and Prophets with proofs and clarifications that what they said and conveyed from Him is the truth without any doubting it, correct without any dispute.
This is the meaning of Qataadah's saying, "Al-Mu'min: He believes in His saying that He is True."
From its meanings is His attesting to the witnesses for Him of tawheed (singling Allaah out alone for worship) and witness for them that what they said is true and correct.

From this meaning is what at-Tirmidhee and Ibn Maajah recorded from Al-Agharr Abu Muslim who narrated that he bears witness from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah, that they bear witness that the Prophet ﷺ said:

"Whoever says: 'There is none worthy of worship except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest, (La ilaha illallah, wa Allahu akbar)' His Lord affirms his statement and says: 'There is none worthy of worship except Me, and I am the Greatest,' and when he says: 'There is none worthy of worship except for Allah, Alone, (La ilaha illallah, wahdahu)' Allah says: 'There is none worthy of worship except for Me and I am Alone.' And when he says: 'There is none worthy of worship except for Allah, Alone, without partner, (La ilaha illallah, wahdahu la sharika lahu)' Allah says: 'There is none worthy of worship except Me, Alone, I have no partner.' And when he says: 'There is none worthy of worship except for Allah, to Him belongs all that exists, and to Him is the praise, (La ilaha illallah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu)' Allah says: 'There is none worthy of worship except Me, to Me belongs all that exists, and to Me is the praise.' And when he says: 'There is none worthy of worship except Allah, and there is no might or power except by Allah, (La ilaha illallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)' Allah says: 'There is none worthy of worship except Me, and there is no might or power except by Me.'" And he used to say: "Whoever says it in his illness, then dies, the Fire shall not consume him."
From its meanings is that Allaah grants security to His believing servants and God-fearing allies from His punishment and penalty. Allaah said,

It is those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah and worship none but Him Alone) and confuse not their belief with Zulm (wrong i.e. by worshipping others besides Allah), for them (only) there is security and they are the guided.
From its meanings is His granting security to those who are fearful by giving them safety which is opposite to fear. As Allaah said,
(He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.
This is the meaning of Ibn 'Abbaas' speech, "Al-Mu'min means that He grants security to His creation that He will not oppress them."
Every fearful person who is sincere in turning to Allaah will find Allaah granting him safety from fear. The safety and security of a slave and of a country is in Allaah's Hand.

keyPoints: The Name Al-Mu'min is found in one aayah, Hashr 59:23.
From its meanings is His witnessing tawheed for Himself, the greatest witness for the greatest of things (Aali 'Imraan 3:18).
It also means He attests His Messengers and Prophets with proofs that what they conveyed is the truth, and He attests to those who witness His tawheed.
It means He grants security to His believing servants from His punishment, and grants safety to the fearful who sincerely turn to Him.
Ibn 'Abbaas said Al-Mu'min means He grants security to His creation that He will not oppress them.

evidence.text: the Giver of security, the Watcher over His creatures
(He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.

recall.q: What are the meanings of Al-Mu'min mentioned by the author?
recall.a: His witnessing tawheed for Himself; attesting His Messengers with proofs; attesting to those who witness His tawheed; granting security to the believers from His punishment; and granting safety to the fearful.
"Al-Mu'min means that He grants security to His creation that He will not oppress them."

recall.q: What does Allaah say when a servant says 'La ilaha illallah, wa Allahu akbar'?
recall.a: His Lord affirms his statement and says: 'There is none worthy of worship except Me, and I am the Greatest.'

recall.q: Which aayah is cited for Allaah granting security to the fearful?
recall.a: '(He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear' (Quraish 106:4).
